clauses: Report each kept status’s signed difference from the mean of kept statuses’ averages.
Report each kept status’s absolute difference from the mean of kept statuses’ averages.
readings: Group signals by RFI status (`rfistat`), with signals that have no status as their own group, and average the modulation index (`modindex`) for each group, ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the overall average modulation index across all signals (each signal counting once), and keep the statuses whose average is above it. For each kept status, show the status, its average modulation index, how far that average is above the baseline, and how far it differs from the mean of the kept statuses' averages. Leave all values unrounded. Report each kept status’s signed difference from the mean of kept statuses’ averages.

Group signals by RFI status (`rfistat`), with signals that have no status as their own group, and average the modulation index (`modindex`) for each group, ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the overall average modulation index across all signals (each signal counting once), and keep the statuses whose average is above it. For each kept status, show the status, its average modulation index, how far that average is above the baseline, and how far it differs from the mean of the kept statuses' averages. Leave all values unrounded. Report each kept status’s absolute difference from the mean of kept statuses’ averages.
queries:
WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
    FROM signals
),
kept AS (
    SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, overall_avg
    FROM status_averages
    CROSS JOIN baseline
    WHERE avg_modindex > overall_avg
)
SELECT
    rfistat,
    avg_modindex,
    avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_baseline,
    avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept

WITH status_averages AS (
    SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
    FROM signals
    GROUP BY rfistat
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg
    FROM signals
),
kept AS (
    SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, sa.avg_modindex - b.overall_avg AS above_baseline
    FROM status_averages AS sa
    CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
    WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.overall_avg
)
SELECT
    rfistat,
    avg_modindex,
    above_baseline,
    ABS(avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM kept)) AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept
